architecture: MobileNetV2 (1280-dim feature vector) + Learned Disease Context Embedding (32-dim) -> Classification Head (2 logits: Mild / Severe)
known_limitations_and_disclaimer: This model estimates disease severity only for crop-disease combinations represented with explicit Mild/Severe labels in the training data. It does not provide universal severity estimation for unsupported diseases. Performance is evaluated on dataset test splits; real-farm deployment requires ongoing calibration with field agronomic imagery.
